issue.title: Multivisor web UI on athena:8100 returns 500 (TemplateNotFound index.html); only the API works

task_type_fields.impact:
Bryan cannot use the Multivisor web UI from any device. That UI is the browser path for
controlling the root and user Supervisors, and the reason 8100 stays open on the tailnet.
task_type_fields.location: athena ~/.local/pipx/venvs/multivisor (multivisor.server web templates); user Supervisor program supervisor:multivisor
task_type_fields.repro:
On athena as bryan (2026-10-23 16:50 EDT):

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8100/          # 500
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/data  # 401 (API works)
```

The `supervisor:multivisor` log shows `jinja2.exceptions.TemplateNotFound: index.html` for
every `GET /`. The pipx venv `~/.local/pipx/venvs/multivisor` (installed 2025-06-14;
`multivisor.py` patched 2026-10-21 by bob-cli-an.1) has no `templates/` or built frontend
under `site-packages/multivisor/server/`. The browser UI therefore cannot render at all.
Only the authenticated JSON API and the chezmoi `multivisor-cli --url athena:8100` alias
work. Epic bob-cli-an.6 (phase 6.3) kept port 8100 reachable from the tailnet for this UI,
per decision `multivisor_web_access = tailnet`.

Fix: install multivisor with its built web assets (the PyPI wheel or source plus the
`multivisor/server` Vue build), keeping the bob-cli-an.1 patch. Alternatively, decide with
Bryan to drop the web UI and keep API/CLI only. In that case, also narrow the 8100 audience
in tailnet `hosts/athena/supervisor/`. Verify `GET /` returns 200 after login and that
`verify_user_supervisor.py` still passes.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the bob-cli-an.6 lander while re-verifying the 8100 tailnet audience: the installed multivisor package has no web frontend, so the UI the boundary keeps reachable cannot render.

payload.description: av kept 8100 tailnet-reachable for this web UI
